policy: At least 10 characters, letters plus a digit or symbol.
policyTooShort: The password must have at least 10 characters.
policyCharacters: Use letters and at least one digit or symbol.

setup.title: Set up {{brand}}
setup.intro: Choose a master passphrase and create the first administrator account.
setup.introExistingVault: This installation has no user accounts yet. Enter the existing master passphrase and create the first administrator.
setup.passphraseInfo: The master passphrase encrypts all platform credentials and signs the audit log. It is needed after every restart to unlock the tool (or provide it in a file: SM_MASTER_PASSPHRASE_FILE). It cannot be recovered – keep it safe, e.g. in your company password manager.
setup.demoHint: Demo mode – pick any passphrase (min. 12 characters).

login.title: Sign in to {{brand}}
login.vaultLocked: The vault is locked. After signing in, an administrator can unlock it.
login.ssoOnly: Sign in with your company account.
login.ssoOnlyNoProvider: Password sign-in is turned off and no single sign-on provider is enabled. An administrator can get in with emergency access from the server's command line.
login.emergencyLink: Emergency access (administrators, with a link from the server)

changePassword.newPasswordsDiffer: The new passwords do not match.

forced.title: Choose a new password
forced.intro: Welcome {{name}}. Your account uses a temporary password – please choose your own before continuing.

vault.waitingIntro: {{brand}} was restarted and its vault is locked. An administrator has to unlock it with the master passphrase before you can continue.
vault.unlockIntro: Enter the master passphrase to decrypt credentials, verify the audit log and start schedules.

emergency.title: Emergency access
emergency.intro: This one-time link was created on the server with steward admin emergency-access. It works once, within its time window.
emergency.codeHint: The part after #code= in the link the command printed.
emergency.signedIn: You are signed in already. Sign out first to use an emergency access link.
emergency.banner: Emergency access – fix the sign-in, then sign out. This session ends at {{time}} at the latest; your actions are marked in the audit log and the other administrators were notified.
